articles.title: SteamVR 2.19.3 Beta and SteamOS 0.5.9 Beta for Steam Frame released
articles.summary: Valve released both SteamVR 2.19.3 Beta for all VR gamers, and SteamOS 0.5.9 Beta for Steam Frame as well. Here's all that's new and improved.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
articles.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon has become the first non-OpenAI model in a while to top the MathArena math benchmark. It knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top spot, while Claude Fable 5.2 came in second, making it potentially one of the most capable publicly available models for math tasks.

articles.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
articles.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol.

articles.title: RPN Loved Honk If (or, Write Your Own PostScript Interpreter)
articles.summary: Maybe you like old laser printers. Maybe you were a fan of [Don Lancaster]. Maybe you like Forth, HP calculators, and everything RPN. Whichever it is, why not write your own PostScript interpreter ?

articles.title: Hands-on: ESR’s MagSafe kickstand charger solves two key iPhone Duo shortcomings
articles.summary: iPhone Duo, because it offers a much larger inside display, means theres all tons of new use cases that you wouldn’t normally come across with your iPhone.

articles.title: Pixel 11 Pro’s HiLight feature also now works on WhatsApp messages
articles.summary: As a part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop that was released this week , Google Messages added support for HiLight on the Pixel 11 Pro series.

articles.title: Proton Experimental fixes ArcheAge Chronicles, Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, Deep Rock Galactic
articles.summary: Valve pushed out a small update for Proton Experimental, fixing issues in a few specific games. This follows on from the last update on November 10th .

articles.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
articles.summary: Anthropic has made Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on all paid plans and published a guide that does away with old prompting habits. The main takeaway is to drop "think hard" and start at Medium effort.

articles.title: Wine 11.22 brings improved support for ARM64, MSXML and address space randomisation
articles.summary: Address space randomisation is an interesting one for security, as it makes the locations of programs and data in memory less predictable. Making certain memory-based exploits harder to carry out.

articles.title: SteamOS 3.10.0 Preview brings HDMI 2.1 VRR, FRL, and ALLM for AMD and improvements for NVIDIA
articles.summary: Valve released SteamOS 3.10.0 Preview which brings a pretty big set of features, especially if you're on an AMD GPU and now improved NVIDIA support too.

articles.title: Redox OS Gets Golang Working, GIMP Ported & Simplified AI Policy
articles.summary: The Rust-based Redox OS open-source operating system is now out with its October development summary that highlights recent software ports, progress on NUMA, and other enhancements made to this from-scratch platform.

articles.title: Rugged Emdoor Laptops Beginning To See Improved Linux Support
articles.summary: Emdoor that is a leading manufacturer of rugged laptops and tablets used by various industries is beginning to see improved Linux support thanks to a new platform driver being developed.

articles.title: From desktop to cloud to road
articles.summary: Traditional automotive engineering treats every environment, including desktop, cloud, and target electronic control unit (ECU), as a unique universe. Development teams write code on x86 workstations and validate algorithms on cloud instances.
